section: SCHOLARSHIP
text:
SCHOLARSHIP
State Scholarship Portal (SSP)
SSP Scholarship is an initiative taken by the Government of Karnataka to provide financial aid to engineering students. It offers pre-matric and    post-matric scholarships to SC/ ST, Backward Classes students.
Scholarship for Engineering Students
Eligibility:
Karnataka students studying engineering in Karnataka.
The candidate must score at least 50% in their previous examinations.
How to Apply? : SSP portal: ONLINE

section: For All Category OBC Students: (Offered by Backward Classes Welfare Department)
text:
For All Category OBC Students: (Offered by Backward Classes Welfare Department)
Eligibility: The annual family income must not exceed 1.5 lacs.
What do you get?: Yearly Rs.19,200 only

section: For SC-ST Students (Offered by Social Welfare Department)
text:
For SC-ST Students (Offered by Social Welfare Department)
Students through only CET are eligible.
Eligibility: The annual family income Rs.10,000 to 2.5 Lakhs.
What do you get?: Yearly CET Tuition Fee only

section: For SC-ST Students (Offered by Department of Technical Education)
text:
For SC-ST Students (Offered by Department of Technical Education)
Students through only CET are eligible.
Eligibility: The annual family income Rs.2.5 Lakhs to10 Lakhs
What do you get?: CET Tuition fee of that academic year
(E-attestation of parent’s salary certificate)

section: National Scholarship Portal (NSP)
text:
National Scholarship Portal (NSP)
Scholarship for Minority students
The annual family income must not exceed 1.5 lakhs.
What do you get: Yearly Rs.50,000
How to Apply? : NSP portal: https://scholarships.gov.in/

section: Department of labour welfare
text:
Department of labour welfare
Applicable only for children of daily wages workers
The annual family income must not exceed 01 lakh.
What do you get: Yearly Rs.50,000 only
How to Apply?: ONLINE

section: Scholarship from Youth Empowerment and Sports Department
text:
Scholarship from Youth Empowerment and Sports Department
Only for students who represented in District/State Level Competitions
The annual family income must not exceed 1.5 lakh.
What do you get: Yearly Rs.25,000 only
How to Apply? : OFFLINE MODE

section: Department for the Empowerment of Differently Abled-Scholarship
text:
Department for the Empowerment of Differently Abled-Scholarship
The annual income must not exceed 2.5 lakhs.
What do you get: CET Tuition fee of each year.
How to Apply? : OFFLINE MODE

section: Scholarship for Children of Ex-Army Staffs
text:
Scholarship for Children of Ex-Army Staffs
No limit on annual income
What do you get: Yearly Rs.15,000
How to Apply? : OFFLINE MODE

section: Scholarship from Department of Railways (only for children of railway department
text:
Scholarship from Department of Railways (only for children of railway department employees)
No limit on annual income
What do you get: Yearly Rs.20,000
How to Apply? : OFFLINE MODE

section: KSRTC Employees Educational Fund.
text:
KSRTC Employees Educational Fund.
What do you get: Yearly Rs.10,000 only
How to Apply? : OFFLINE MODE

section: Scholarship from COFFEE Board, Bengaluru
text:
Scholarship from COFFEE Board, Bengaluru
Applicable only for children whose parents are working at any Coffee Curing Works
What do you get: Yearly Rs.12,000 only
How to Apply? : ONLINE

section: Teachers Scholarship from Education Department
text:
Teachers Scholarship from Education Department
Only for students whose Parents are working Government Teachers
What do you get: Yearly Rs.10,000 only
How to Apply?: OFFLINE MODE

section: Non-Government Scholarships
text:
Non-Government Scholarships
Sitaram Jindal Foundation Scholarship (Both CET and Management students)
The annual family income must not exceed 2.5 lakhs.
What do you get: Yearly Rs.30,000
How to Apply?: OFFLINE MODE & ONLINE

The annual family income must not exceed 1.5 lakhs.
